ideas.claim: A certificate that records the actual domain, base field, subgroup, kernel and action type can distinguish certified scalar-action statements from invalid or underdeclared transfers on a preregistered 12-card mathematical fixture set, without using relation rank or solver performance as evidence.
ideas.mechanism: Scalar restriction is an assertion about an invariant cyclic group. The same map name may otherwise refer to full geometric torsion, an action defined only over an extension, an action with kernel on the subgroup, or an affine torsion translation. A typed domain/codomain certificate exposes these changes before a representation's observations are interpreted.

ideas.object: Finite algebraic fiber with separate reduced-support and multiplicity annotations.
ideas.claim: A six-fixture certificate can distinguish a change of representation from a change of reduced solution support when specialization introduces repeated factors, vanishing coefficients or exceptional denominators. It must flag every deliberately mismatched support claim while retaining valid multiplicity changes as such.
ideas.mechanism: The same visible polynomial degree can conceal different geometric support, and the same support can carry different multiplicity. Specializing a parameter can change either. Recording ambient field, parameter value, excluded locus, reduced support and multiplicities separately makes an otherwise ambiguous degree comparison auditable. This is a prerequisite to interpreting a representation comparison, not a new elimination method.
assumptions: Fixtures are elementary univariate or finite explicitly listed fibers over a stated field; no summation system is solved.
Degree, root support, scheme length where defined, and rational point count are separate quantities.
Each certificate states its characteristic restrictions and every inversion used; absent certificates stay unresolved.
discriminated_from: IDEA-20260807-1ea327 proposes invariant norm encodings and their degree tradeoff; this proposal introduces no encoding, norm computation or phase recovery.
IDEA-20260807-e57607 compares solving-degree behavior across arities; this diagnostic compares semantic labels under specialization without a solver or arity-growth claim.

IDEA-20260726-002, IDEA-20260727-001, IDEA-20260807-b42544 and IDEA-20260807-9ecc6f concern matrix structure, quotient rank or cost; no matrix is formed here. IDEA-20260807-45a69f concerns long orbits and table costs, which this diagnostic does not measure.

proof_search_map.bottleneck: A specialized polynomial's low degree or repeated factors cannot alone certify preservation of the intended relation fiber.

baseline_embedding.parameter_slice: A fixed square-free univariate polynomial with all coefficients and domain specified.
baseline_embedding.reproduction_check: The annotated certificate must agree with its explicitly supplied distinct-root list and treat every multiplicity as one.

observation_collision.observable: Total degree or unlabelled root count.
observation_collision.distinct_preimage_search: Compare same-degree polynomials with repeated versus distinct roots, and distinct polynomials having equal reduced support but different multiplicities.

constructive_transforms.predicted_gain: Six fully classified fixtures, zero conflations of support with multiplicity; no speedup.

proof_search_map.quantifier_order: For each declared specialization, certify only the fiber at that parameter. Existence of one regular specialization does not imply regularity for every parameter; agreement on tested fibers does not establish generic flatness.

method_ceiling.strongest_certifiable_claim: Exact distinctions for six fully stated elementary fibers.
method_ceiling.nearby_object_control: A repeated-root specialization and a denominator-zero specialization must fail the corresponding regular-fiber certificate even if their displayed degree is small.

proof_obligations.claim: Positive control support lists and multiplicities satisfy their stated polynomial identities.
Exceptional-locus exclusions are declared before any comparison.
Finite fiber inspection supports no generic complexity bound.

predictions.minimum_effect: 2 of 2 valid regular controls retained; two exceptional cases explicitly labelled.

minimal_test.design: Propose six paper fixtures: two regular controls, two support/multiplicity mismatches, and two exceptional-locus specializations. Freeze factorization witnesses and labels first. Apply the same certificate to all six and record disagreements; do not invoke Groebner computation.
controls: Excluded denominator and a matching regular parameter.
required_metrics: Six-way fixture table of support, multiplicity, degree and exceptional status.
minimal_test.proposed_budget: Six fixtures, at most 60 minutes in a later separately approved design; zero target queries.

falsification_conditions: Any invalid support equivalence is certified by degree equality alone.
A valid multiplicity change is misreported as loss of reduced points.
A proposed exceptional fixture lacks an exact witness and is nevertheless given a definitive label.
confounders: Non-flat families and implicit denominator cancellation.
required_artifacts: Six frozen polynomial/fiber statements and supplied witnesses.
Separate support and multiplicity tables.
Exceptional-locus declarations and unresolved cases.
Charged inspection time and certificate sizes.

target_complexity.tradeoff_note: No time-memory solver tradeoff. Certificates are diagnostic output.

ideas.object: A finite orbit partition with an invariant event and declared sampling measure.
ideas.claim: On three hand-specified finite partitions, a measure certificate can recover the exact point-uniform event rate from complete orbit data while exposing disagreement with orbit-uniform sampling when unequal orbit sizes correlate with the event. Relabelling alone must produce zero change.
ideas.mechanism: An orbit selected uniformly gives each orbit the same mass; a uniformly selected point gives an orbit mass proportional to its size. These are distinct estimands. A certificate records the population, orbit sizes, inclusion rule and event constancy. The elementary weighted identity is diagnostic bookkeeping and does not assert the distribution of real CM relations or independence of successive samples.
assumptions: The complete finite partition and all event labels are supplied, not inferred from a random walk.
The event is orbit-invariant, or per-point labels are supplied; representative-only labels for a non-invariant event are insufficient.
Weights and denominator refer to the same population; omitted or zero-inclusion strata remain unresolved.
discriminated_from: IDEA-20260807-b42544 audits rank increment and matched cardinality; this proposal audits the probability measure before a rate comparison and never computes rank.
IDEA-20260727-001 addresses orbit quotient and rank degeneracy; no quotient linear system or historical measurement is checked here.

IDEA-20260726-002 and IDEA-20260807-9ecc6f discuss matrix structure and cost, IDEA-20260807-45a69f long-orbit table reduction, and IDEA-20260807-1ea327/e57607 polynomial encodings and degrees. The deliverable here is instead an exact finite-population estimand certificate.

proof_search_map.bottleneck: A rate difference may reflect orbit selection weights rather than the proposed structural effect.

baseline_embedding.parameter_slice: Equal-size orbits with an orbit-invariant event.
baseline_embedding.reproduction_check: Point-uniform and orbit-uniform rates must coincide exactly.

observation_collision.observable: An unweighted histogram of orbit event labels.
observation_collision.distinct_preimage_search: Keep event labels fixed and vary declared orbit sizes; the histogram stays fixed while the point-uniform event probability may change.

constructive_transforms.proposed_object: Population, inclusion measure and orbit-size annotated event table.
constructive_transforms.predicted_gain: Three exact population identities and zero label-dependent residual; no algorithmic improvement.

proof_search_map.quantifier_order: For every fully supplied finite partition and invariant event, the weighted mean equals the point-uniform mean by counting. No assertion says a cryptographic sampler realizes that measure or independent draws.

method_ceiling.strongest_certifiable_claim: Exact rates for the three finite populations and correct indication of missing sampling information.
method_ceiling.nearby_object_control: An arbitrary relabelled partition of identical sizes and event labels must yield identical rates; structural names must not affect the measurement.

proof_obligations.claim: Weights normalize to the total declared population size.
The event and sampling unit are identical across compared rates.
A finite counting identity supplies no mixing or relation-density theorem.

predictions.minimum_effect: Exactly 0 on all three supplied partitions.
A designed partition of sizes 1 and 3 with event on the singleton has orbit-uniform rate 1/2 and point-uniform rate 1/4; predicted gap 1/4, not an observed result.
Exactly 0; the equal-size control also has measure gap 0.

minimal_test.design: Propose three exact paper populations: two equal-size orbits, orbits of sizes 1 and 3 with singleton event, and a relabelled copy of the unequal-size population. Supply all labels and compare point-uniform, orbit-uniform and size-weighted rates. Add a missing-inclusion annotation to demonstrate why a real sampler cannot inherit the counting identity without evidence.
controls: Non-invariant event annotation must require full within-orbit labels.
required_metrics: Exact rational event rates and residuals.
minimal_test.execution_status: Proposed only; no random sampling or relation collection performed.
minimal_test.proposed_budget: Three finite partitions with at most eight total elements per partition; 30 minutes in a later approved design, zero target queries.

falsification_conditions: A weighted rate differs from direct complete-population counting.
A representative label is silently applied to an event that varies within its orbit.
Missing inclusion probabilities are replaced by presumed uniformity.
confounders: Fixed points and shorter exceptional orbits.
Correlated samples; the certificate does not estimate uncertainty for them.
required_artifacts: Three frozen populations and complete event labels.
Exact rational rate worksheet.
Declared inclusion rules and unresolved cases.
Inspection time and worksheet size.

target_complexity.time_exponent: No ECDLP exponent; O(M) arithmetic to inspect an explicitly supplied population of M elements, M <= 8 per fixture.
target_complexity.memory_exponent: No ECDLP exponent; O(M) supplied labels, with constant-space aggregation possible.
target_complexity.best_known: No change to square-root or automorphism-adjusted solver baselines.
target_complexity.hidden_overhead: Obtaining a real orbit partition, inclusion probabilities or mixing guarantee is unpriced and not claimed feasible.
target_complexity.tradeoff_note: Streaming a supplied table changes storage only; no solver parallelization or data-query advantage.

ideas.object: A mathematical dependency manifest paired with explicit transport obligations.
ideas.claim: An eight-case paper audit can distinguish justified reuse of a precomputed representation certificate from stale reuse after a relevant parameter changes, while allowing purely syntactic relabelling only when its transport witness is supplied. It must detect all four deliberately invalid reuse claims without mistaking a cache identifier for mathematical validity.
ideas.mechanism: Equal stored bytes or matching human-readable curve labels establish neither equal mathematical inputs nor a valid pullback. A reuse certificate records field presentation, curve model, subgroup, action, representation map, exceptional locus and target-dependence scope. A changed component requires either invalidation or a checked transport statement. This exposes the boundary across which setup costs may be amortized.
assumptions: Only synthetic dependency records and supplied elementary transport statements are inspected.
Each fixture declares whether its object is target-independent or target-specialized; the declaration itself needs justification.
A cryptographic hash is an integrity pointer, not a proof of semantic equivalence; changed model names alone neither prove nor disprove it.
discriminated_from: IDEA-20260807-45a69f prices long-orbit tables and incidence; this proposal constructs no table and concerns the validity domain of reuse, not a table reduction.

IDEA-20260807-1ea327 and IDEA-20260807-e57607 mention target-dependent polynomial representations; this diagnostic records which mathematical dependencies may change before their precomputation loses its certificate.

IDEA-20260726-002, IDEA-20260727-001, IDEA-20260807-b42544 and IDEA-20260807-9ecc6f concern matrix structures, ranks and quotient costs. None of those conclusions is retested; the new object is a transport and amortization boundary certificate.

proof_search_map.bottleneck: Amortized accounting is invalid if supposedly reusable setup changes its mathematical meaning between instances.

baseline_embedding.parameter_slice: Exactly identical complete dependency manifest and unchanged certified statement.
baseline_embedding.reproduction_check: Accept identity transport without adding new setup obligations; still charge checking and storage.

observation_collision.observable: The same cache name, CM discriminant or raw coefficient list.
observation_collision.distinct_preimage_search: Hold the name or coefficient bytes fixed while varying the field presentation, subgroup/action binding or target-specialization value.

constructive_transforms.proposed_object: Dependency manifest plus validity-preserving transport certificate.
constructive_transforms.predicted_gain: Eight explicit reuse decisions and zero unsupported amortization claims; no measured cost saving.

proof_search_map.quantifier_order: For every proposed reuse within a declared domain, require a statement preserving the certified property under that reuse. One valid transport for one pair does not imply a transport for every curve sharing its CM label.

method_ceiling.strongest_certifiable_claim: Correct classification of eight supplied identity, changed-dependency and missing-evidence fixtures.
method_ceiling.nearby_object_control: A changed target inside a target-specialized certificate must be invalidated or re-certified despite unchanged cache name and curve.

proof_obligations.claim: The manifest lists every dependency of the asserted certificate.
An accepted transport preserves the stated property and its exceptional-domain restrictions.
Construction, validation, transport and persistent storage costs are each charged once where incurred.
No result transfers to an unlisted field, subgroup or target domain.

predictions.minimum_effect: 2 of 2 identity or explicitly transported controls accepted.
2 of 2 underdeclared cases remain unresolved with named missing obligations.

minimal_test.design: Propose eight hand-authored record pairs: two valid identity/transport pairs, four countermodels changing field interpretation, subgroup/action binding, representation-domain restriction or specialized parameter, and two missing-proof cases. Freeze expected decisions and elementary witnesses. Inspect the dependency contract without building a cache, polynomial solver or precomputation pipeline.
controls: Same bytes interpreted over a different declared field.
Changed specialized parameter under unchanged file name.
required_metrics: Separate setup, verification, transport and storage charge categories.
minimal_test.execution_status: Not run and not approved for execution.
minimal_test.proposed_budget: Eight record pairs, at most 60 minutes in a later approved design; zero target queries or precomputation runs.

falsification_conditions: Any deliberately incompatible record pair is accepted on identifier equality.
Valid explicit transport is rejected solely because serialization changes.
Unknown equivalence is reported as false equivalence or as permission to amortize.
A cost category disappears merely because the artifact is reused.
confounders: Field encoding versus abstract field isomorphism.
Target-independent ingredients mixed with target-specialized ones.
Incomplete manifests; their completeness is a proof obligation, not guaranteed by this proposal.
required_artifacts: Eight frozen dependency-record pairs.
Witnesses for every accepted transport and invalid-reuse control.
Named unresolved obligations.
A symbolic cost ledger, without fabricated timing values.

target_complexity.time_exponent: No ECDLP exponent; eight finite manifest/certificate inspections.
target_complexity.memory_exponent: No ECDLP exponent; eight record pairs plus explicit transport witnesses.
target_complexity.best_known: Applicable square-root and automorphism-adjusted baselines unchanged.
target_complexity.hidden_overhead: Proving manifest completeness and general transport may be difficult; no polynomial bound or amortization gain asserted.
target_complexity.tradeoff_note: Setup, verification, transport and storage remain separate. Parallel checking does not imply reusable setup across targets.
